Context: 9. Benefits to the families of Government servants who go missing during service

time to time.  
In all those cases where on re-appearing of Government servant whose whereabouts were not known, and where benefits under DoP&PW., OM, dated 25-6-2013 have been paid, the quantum of family pension awarded exceeds the recoverable emoluments, the matter needs to be settled in consultation with Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare and Department of Expenditure. - OM, dated 28-4-2022.
